nom: Origins Youthtopia Apple Butter Cleansing Balm

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including midlife and drier autumn/winter skin, generally report it cleanses without leaving skin tight or stripped, often citing improved softness.
segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers, including some who initially worried the buttery texture would be too rich, report it rinses clean without leaving a greasy film and controls shine well.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers consistently report no irritation or breakouts, with several specifically praising it as gentle enough for reactive or fragrance-sensitive skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one dealing with humidity, describe it deep-cleaning oilier areas like the T-zone while leaving drier areas soft and not stripped.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers in midlife or approaching 50 report the balm leaving their skin soft and hydrated, without describing any specific anti-aging effect.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, across skin types, report the balm cleanses without leaving skin feeling tight, dry, or stripped, and several specifically say it leaves skin hydrated; one reviewer, however, described a residue that felt both oily and dry at once and did not find it moisturizing.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the apple seed oil and shea butter with supporting their moisture barrier, reporting skin that feels nourished rather than stripped after cleansing.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers report less redness around the nose or cheeks since using the balm, with no dissenting reports of increased redness.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the balm gets along well with their skin, including one whose skin cleared up and another whose acne-treatment-related dryness it helped soothe, with no reports of new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers mostly say it rinses off completely without leaving a greasy film, though a couple of reviewers, including one who still double-cleanses afterward, found it left a slightly greasy or tacky feeling.

aspects.libelle: Buttery balm that melts into a milky texture
Scent can be too strong for some
Squeeze tube seen as more hygienic and less messy than a tub
Doesn't fully remove heavy or waterproof makeup alone
Can sting eyes when removing heavy eye makeup

extraits.titre: Very watery or oily and doesn't smell very good
extraits.texte: I'm not sure if I misunderstanding the point of this or what but it's really weird. It's a very thin cream and I got it because of that apple butter description, but it has a funny, almost funky oil smell. I've used it a few times but I'm struggling to continue to use it because it just leaves my skin with this weird residue feeling that somehow both oily and slightly dry at the same time. It seems like it might help with moisture a little bit but I've had to use a lot of it to get any notable effect. I would not buy this again and you probably shouldn't either. This one is a swing and a miss.

extraits.titre: An okay product. Not for me
extraits.texte: Personally for me I wasn't a huge fan of this. It left my face feeling greasy and take feeling. I also wasn't a huge fan of the scent. It worked great cleaning everything off my face but just left my face not feeling great afterwards.

When I first started using this cleansing balm, I'm not going to lie, I thought that it may be just a little too rich for my oily-leaning combination type skin. However, I have now come to very much appreciate it for its gentle, soothing nature. When I first rinsed it off I felt like it left a very fine moisturizing layer on my skin, but after my skin had dried I was simply left with a cleansed yet hydrated feeling. I almost feel like, with my skin type, this cleanser is so nourishing that I could skip the moisturizer; at least with the humid, summertime weather that I'm currently experiencing. I also wasn't sure if this cleansing balm would play well with my acne-prone skin, but I'm happy to say that they get along quite nicely. In fact, I have been using an acne-treatment that is a bit drying and actually causes my skin some peeling, but this cleanser has been really helpful at mitigating its drying effects. To conclude my thoughts, I think that this cleansing balm is perfectly suitable to almost any skin type, however, I do feel that it would work especially well for those who have drier skin types. I also think that this is a product that can work for any time of year, but would be particularly wonderful for the drier autumn & winter months when, more often than not, our skin could use a little extra nourishment. So, with all that being said, I do enjoy this cleansing balm very much and would happily recommend it to anyone looking for a deeply nourishing, moisturizing cle

Gifted by Youthtopia. I have dry skin, and finding a cleanser that doesn't leave my face feeling tight is always a challenge. Apple Butter Cleansing Face Balm has been a really nice addition to my routine. It has a smooth, buttery texture that melts down easily and takes off my makeup without much effort, even mascara and foundation come off quickly. After rinsing, my skin feels clean but not stripped or dry, which I really appreciate. I still follow up with moisturizer, but this balm definitely helps my skin feel softer and more comfortable compared to regular cleansers.

Okay, as a 41 year old with combo skin in this humidity, finding a good cleanser is tough. But Youthtopia Apple Butter Cleansing Balm is genuinely great. It smells subtly of apple, and the buttery texture melts right in, dissolving all my makeup and grime. It deep cleans my T-zone without stripping and leaves my drier areas soft and nourished. Crucially, it rinses completely clean, no greasy film, which is vital for humidity. My skin feels balanced and fresh, able to breathe. If you've got combo skin and battle humidity, this balm is a legitimate game-changer. Seriously, try it. Gifted by Origins.

This has a fruity and cozy scent that is just lovely, especially for when you've had a long day. I use it as first step in my double cleaning routine to break down makeup, sunscreen and oil. Its creamy texture turns into a lightweight milk as it washes off your skin impurities. I was pleasantly surprised at how gentle it is on oily skin like mine. It manages to cleanse without stripping the skin. Complimentary from Origins
